```python
import pixeltable as pxt
from pixeltable.iterators import FrameIterator

# Access the existing videos table
videos = pxt.get_table('videos')

# Create a view that expands each video into one row per frame at 1 fps
frames_view = videos.create_view(
    name='video_frames',
    iterator=FrameIterator(video_column='video', fps=1)
)

print(f"Created view: {frames_view.get_name()}")
```
